extraction.tool: Original native scan / closed-form edge alpha and foreground decontamination
extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. Keep ONLY the complete connected GRAY ACANTHUS network in the bottom margin: all three large source curled lobes, the gray central connecting branches, every pointed folded gray leaf and all actual thin gray terminal flourishes. Keep the whole connected network together, not three independently dismembered curls. Remove the gold/tan field, fine brown vine crossing behind it, all separate blue/red flowers and green/gold leaves, page/text and black outer frame. Preserve the gray forms exactly where the original brown vine or other artwork occludes them; do not invent hidden gray stem pieces or reshape leaves. Clear all genuine scroll openings and keep pale gray body fills opaque. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Whole original and white/dark results reviewed, including native-scale gray folds, the actual connected upper-right terminal, the lower point crossing the original frame rule and the green-leaf interface. False page baseline and independent leaf-root remnants removed. All original gray contact branches remain one ornament, genuine openings clear, source RGB unscaled.

assets.usage_notes: Whole original contacting three-curl gray acanthus network, including its connected upper-right folded terminal and source-visible lower tip. Exterior gilt field, independent green foliage, paper and page rules are transparent. Native scan RGB retained at original scale, with continuous edge alpha; no invented hidden tips or SVG approximation.
